purpose: Teach: アラスカ/アインシュタイン/トライアル/電話機/ブーツ/石鹸/キャスター/セレクト

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがアラスカの絵本、お見せするわ
lines.en: Sho, I want to show you this Alaska picture book.
lines.style: Warm, inviting opening. Gentle but engaged. Leans toward him slightly. Patient pause after his name, like offering him a gift.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、アインシュタイン博士って知ってる
lines.en: Mei-sis… do you know who Doctor Einstein is?
lines.style: Curious, sudden spark of interest. Soft but piercing. Looks up at her with genuine wonder, not performing. Quick tempo on the question.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、新しいおもちゃのトライアル、お父さんと試そうね
lines.en: Sho, why don't we try out this new toy with your dad?
lines.style: Warm invitation without pressure. Light, encouraging tone. Slight lift at the end like opening a door. Present and genuinely interested in his response.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お家の電話機、ぼく初めて使ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I used the home phone for the first time today.
lines.style: Small, genuine pride in his voice. Straightforward delivery, no embellishment. Quiet confidence. Watching for her reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、雨の日のブーツ、お洒落でしょ
lines.en: Sho, those rain boots are really stylish, aren't they?
lines.style: Warm approval, noticing. Bright but not overdone. Genuine delight in what he's chosen. Expects agreement but not demanding it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、香りつきの石鹸、好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really like the scented soap.
lines.style: Small, contented voice. Direct and uncomplicated. Sharing something he noticed and liked. Unhurried, genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、テレビのキャスターさん、頑張ってらっしゃるわよね
lines.en: Sho, that TV news anchor really is doing her best, isn't she?
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Slight pensiveness underneath. Speaking almost to herself, but including him. Respectful attention to the anchor's effort.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、おもちゃをセレクトするの楽しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, picking out toys is so much fun.
lines.style: Bright, unguarded enthusiasm. Speaks with discovery and joy. Wants to share this feeling with her. Slight warmth at the end, like he's including her in something good.
